summary: Henry Schein filed a routine 8-K reporting an amendment and restatement of its revolving credit facility. On September 21, 2026, the company, with JPMorgan Chase as administrative agent and a bank syndicate, increased aggregate commitments from $1 billion to $1.25 billion and extended the termination date to September 19, 2031, while modifying certain financial definitions and covenants. Proceeds support working capital, capital expenditures, stock repurchases, permitted refinancing, and potential acquisitions. No board recommendation, advisor, price, premium, or deal terms are stated; this is an ordinary credit-facility event, not a special situation.
